name: 厲若楓
oneLiner: 爭論時一句話都不插，等他開口，說的是別人都沒看見的東西。

persona.gender: 男（依動畫參考與美術規範；docs/02 部分段落用「她」，疑為筆誤，待確認）
persona.identity: 天玄院第七室舍友，弓修
persona.appearance: 身形修長偏瘦、精實，站姿安靜，重心常落在一條腿上。短而凌亂的黑髮蓋過眉毛，一雙琥珀色眼睛，目光總跟著人的腳步走（推斷）。深大地棕與橄欖褐色合身交領短袍、綁袖，領口一條摺起的深色圍巾，不戴兜帽（推斷）；背後斜掛一把三段式摺疊短弓，深色漆木三節、銅製關節，右腰一只小圓筒漆箭匣（推斷）。左肩頂有一道淡淡的舊傷疤，在領口邊緣隱約可見。弓帶磨過的右肩布料褪色不勻（推斷）。
persona.temperament: 大部分時間只用眼睛，不搶話。開口前總有一個停頓，說出來的是觀察結論而不是意見，語氣始終平靜。
persona.motivation: 看清楚再動手——每次沉默都在計算下一步。
persona.arc: 不加入爭論、只看玩家腳步，第一章冷眼旁觀、精準解圍，之後才開始承認同伴

image.prompt: A slim, wiry young East Asian man around twenty, an archer cultivator of an ancient-Chinese-inspired mountain academy, quiet still posture with weight resting on one leg, wearing a close-fitting cross-collar short robe in dark earth brown and olive umber with narrow bound sleeves, a folded dark collar scarf with no hood, a woven cloth belt, dark trousers and wrapped soft boots; a compact three-section folding short bow — three jointed segments of dark lacquered wood with bronze joint fittings — slung diagonally across his back; a small cylindrical lacquered arrow case at the right hip; a faint pale old scar across the top of the left shoulder, just visible at the collar edge. Slender face with a narrow chin, slightly deep-set almond eyes with warm amber irises and a steady tracking gaze, straight thin eyebrows, a small closed mouth; short messy black hair falling over the brows, a little longer at the nape. Soft dull-finish cotton and suede, the brown robe faded unevenly at the right shoulder where the bow strap rubs. Three-quarter view, waist-up, plain neutral background. Soft directional key light from the upper left with a cool fill, gentle falloff, ambient occlusion under the chin and in the folds; shallow depth of field with the face in sharpest focus. earth brown, olive umber and bronze palette, soft diffused morning light, ancient-Chinese-inspired cultivation academy, readable silhouette from every angle.
image.promptLocal: 一名約二十歲、身形修長偏瘦而精實的東亞年輕男子，古代中國風格山岳學院的弓修，姿態安靜不動、重心落在一條腿上。身穿深大地棕與橄欖褐色合身交領短袍、綁袖，領口一條摺起的深色圍巾、不戴兜帽，編織布腰帶，深色長褲與綁布軟靴；背後斜掛一把精巧的三段式摺疊短弓——三節深色漆木、銅製關節；右腰一只小圓筒漆箭匣；左肩頂一道淡淡的舊傷疤，在領口邊緣隱約可見。細長臉、下巴窄，略深的杏眼配溫暖的琥珀色虹膜，目光沉穩、追著目標走，細直的眉毛，小嘴閉著；短而凌亂的黑髮垂過眉毛，後頸略長。柔和啞光的棉布與麂皮，弓帶磨過的右肩布料褪色不勻。四分之三視角、半身、純中性背景。左上方柔和主光配冷調補光，光線自然衰減，下巴下方與衣褶有環境遮蔽；淺景深，面部最實。大地棕、橄欖褐與古銅色調、柔和的漫射晨光、古代中國風格修行學院，每個角度輪廓都清楚。

PROPORTIONS ARE CRITICAL: all three figures share exactly the same height, head-to-body ratio and costume details; anatomy must be correct and natural — correct limb lengths, correct head size relative to the body, feet planted on the ground line; no stretching, squashing or foreshortening to make a figure fit the space.
